sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment on, Alpha Route commenced; heading down Queen St.
Corner of Queen & Wyndham St, streets still fairly empty, no issues.
Corner of Queen & Shortland St, same observation, no issues.
T4 Square, sweep of the area; moderate flow of civilians, no concerning issues.
Standing by at Britomart McDonald's to display presence, re the male vagrant reported there earlier this week.
Leaving Britomart McDonald's; heading back up Queen St.
New World Metro — a vagrant outside gathering his belongings, appears to be relocating; no concerns.
Quick check of Vulcan Lane; brief sweep carried out.
Call from Jo & Joes regarding a vagrant loitering in their lobby; assistance requested to move him along.
Call back from Jo & Joes — the male removed himself from the vicinity; no further issues.
Inspected the area to ensure the male had left; all clear, resuming route.
The Civic, no concerns in view, all clear.
Aotea Square all clear, no concerns.
Atrium Shopping Centre, carrying out floor checks.
Atrium all clear, no signs of distress or concern.
Heard a commotion nearby — a vagrant in front of Yoyoso in distress; approached to check on the male's welfare.
Male was non-aggressive and received our concern well; standing by to ensure no escalation.
Male has calmed down; resuming usual patrols.
Heading back to HQ for briefing with Team 2.
Briefing with Team 2 concluded; Team 2 covering lower Queen St, Team 1 covering upper Queen St.
Aotea Square, standing by to show presence.
Commencing welfare checks on upper Queen St.
Mayoral Drive, scoping out the area.
Queens Food Court, commencing welfare checks on stores in the vicinity.
Welfare checks on Monster Inn and Nandos, all clear.
Call from Remedy Cafe — a woman screaming up and down Wellesley St, verbally abusing people walking by; staff called for assistance.
Arrived; the female had moved on shortly after contacting us. In-depth description provided; no match spotted en route; will keep a lookout.
Call from Mecca — five individuals out front being disruptive and stopping customers from entering; staff regularly deals with these individuals.

Spoke with the manager; description of the group of five given, including a female reported to Police a number of times for slanging to fellow homeless. Group last seen heading down lower Queen St; photos and an Auror report to follow. Team 2 advised; standing by at Queen St & Wellesley St.
Group has not returned; resuming patrols.
Footlocker welfare check on the way to Mayoral Drive; no reports from staff, all clear.
Welfare checks completed at the following stores, all clear:
Lorne St all clear; welfare check at Sierra Cafe, no issues so far today.
All clear; heading back to the office.
Team 2 dispatched to cover upper High St; charging Ops phone (11%).
Ops phone at 25%; heading out for another patrol down Queen St.
Commencing welfare checks down lower Queen St.
Imperial Lane, floor checks completed; standing by.
T4 Square, area active but no issues of concern; awaiting any response calls.
Call from Ippondo — two vagrants in front of the store; assistance requested to move them away from the entry. Team 2 dispatched.
T4 Square all clear; youths in the area but behaviour satisfactory, no issues.
Taking lunch break; preparing for changeover to the afternoon shift.
Handover completed, no further issues; morning shift concluded.

sections.title: Day Shift — Team 2 (09:10 – 17:00)
items: Debrief with Team 1 complete; commencing patrols onto upper Queen St, welfare checks along the way.
Upper Queen St welfare checks complete, no issues; heading to Aotea Square.
Thorough sweep of Aotea Square, all clear; heading to Victoria St via Federal St.
Federal St all clear; standing by on Victoria St maintaining presence.
While on standby, a convenience store owner reported that a male had stolen a drink, last seen heading down Victoria St West. Description: white male, black jacket and sweatpants, approx 5'9".
Victoria St West all clear; heading down Victoria St to commence patrols up Lorne St.
Welfare checks on Lorne St complete; standing by maintaining presence.
Upper Queen St, no issues or calls; maintaining presence.
Corner of Albert St / Victoria St West; standing by for response calls.
Route changeover advised; Team 2 covering lower CBD.
Heading down Albert St; welfare checks at Albert Mart, Skymart, Scrunchy Millers, all clear.
Lower Albert St; welfare checks on Woolworths and Aotea Gifts, all clear.
Reign N Pour welfare check, all clear.
Commercial Bay; welfare check on McDonald's Britomart, all clear.
Commercial Bay sweep complete, all clear; standing by.

Responded to a call from Mirrou regarding a female customer who seemed suspicious; asked to stand by. Description: female, blonde/orange hair (bun), black jacket, black handbag, maroon-style dress, tattoo on the back of the neck.
Mirrou all clear, no further issues (photo on file); standing by.
Chancery Square / Freyberg Square; welfare checks on High St stores, all clear.
Chancery Square / Freyberg Square sweep complete, all clear.
Fort St check-in — Jo & Joes advised a few vagrants outside and requested assistance moving them along; advised them to move along and they complied; standing by.
Leaving standby; heading back to HQ for debrief with the afternoon shift.
Route changeover with the afternoon shift; Team 2 covering upper CBD.
Commencing welfare sweeps up Victoria St West.
Welfare sweeps up Victoria St West complete, no issues; crossing to Federal St and Albert St.
Federal St and Albert St complete, no issues; heading to Aotea Square.
Aotea Square sweep complete, no further issues; standing by.
Aotea Square all clear; crossing to Lorne St.
Lorne St sweep complete, no further issues; patrolling to Queen St.
Queen St; conducting welfare sweeps on all upper Queen St stores.
Upper Queen St welfare checks complete, no further issues; maintaining presence.
Responded to a call from Team 1 regarding a couple suspected of stealing from Peter Alexander; store manager confirmed no products stolen, no further issues.
Queen St all clear; heading back to HQ for 30-min break.
Break completed; equipment accounted for, handover completed; Team 2 standing down.

sections.title: Afternoon / Evening Shift (14:40 – 22:30)
items: Debrief with Team B complete, nothing to report.
Commencing patrols on lower Queen St.
Welfare checks from Farmers through to the convenience stores completed.
Patrols down Customs St, full sweep, all clear.
Patrols down Fort St complete, all clear.
Commencing patrols down Shortland St toward Jean Batten Place.
Patrols complete on Shortland St and Jean Batten Place, all clear.
Commencing welfare checks on all lower Queen St businesses.
Welfare checks completed, all clear; standing by.
Commencing checks on Durham St West.
Commencing patrols down Durham St East toward High St.
Durham St East completed, all clear.
Heading to High St for a full sweep.
Responding to a call from 188 Queen St.
Arrived at the location but no sign of the caller; tried calling the number again, no answer.
Witnessed a male being assaulted by a vagrant; moved in to apprehend the assailant and reach the victim.
Police arrived and we assisted with the arrest.
Standing by for security presence; Police have left with the POI for processing.
Heading to the office to charge the Ops phone (15%).
Assisted the manager with setting up training for security.
Heading out on patrol to check the surrounding area.
Localito, McDonald's Queen St, Timezone, 77 Convenience and Mid City all clear; heading toward Aotea Square.
Guard arrived — let him, the manager and team up; heading back on patrol up Victoria St.
Victoria St all clear; welfare checks from Woolworths through to 77 Convenience; standing by at corner of Victoria and Federal St.
Heading down Wellesley St toward Lorne St.
Lorne St all clear; welfare checks on businesses completed; heading to check Elliott St and Darby St.
Elliott St and Darby St all clear; heading to the office for a break.
Received a call from Hasi to stand by at Ace.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:35 – 06:30)
items: Patrolling down Queen St, welfare checks along the way.
Welfare check on Q Convenience Store, Queen St, all clear.
Full sweep Commercial Bay and Britomart Station, all clear.
Patrolling toward the Viaduct to check up on our guards and drop off trespass notice papers.
Continuing our route, patrolling up Albert St.
Welfare checks on Albert Mart and the Japanese restaurant, all clear.
Welfare checks on the karaoke bar and Sky Mart Convenience Store, all clear.
Wellesley St and Mayoral Drive all clear.
Full sweep Aotea Square, all clear; standing by.
Standing by in front of Bar101 to show presence.

Approached a male under the influence attempting to push his way into Bar101 after being denied entry for intoxication; he refused to leave the front door. Told him to move along; he complied and walked away with his friend.
Heading back to HQ for floor checks.
Floor checks complete; Alpha Route complete.
Standing by in front of Bar101 to show presence.
Welfare check on McDonald's Queen St, all clear.
Welfare checks on Victoria St and the top of High St.
Full sweep Freyberg area and Chancery Square, all clear.
Patrol through O'Connell St, bottom of High St, Fort St and the White Lady, all clear.
Welfare checks on Gore St and Auckland Harbour Suites, all clear; Beta Route complete.
Welfare checks on Britomart and Commercial Bay, all clear.
Welfare check on the carpark next to Chemist Warehouse, all clear.
Welfare checks on Aotea Square and Mayoral Drive, all clear.
Welfare check on 77 Convenience Store, Victoria St, all clear.
Welfare check on Albert Mart Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare checks on Customs St and Custom Mart Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare checks on Fort Lane and Jo & Joe, Fort St, all clear.
Welfare checks on High St and High Street Supermarket, all clear.
Welfare checks on Chancery Square, Freyberg area and upper High St, all clear.
Welfare checks on Lorne St and Auckland Library, all clear; Delta Route complete.
Checks on Darby St and Elliott St, all clear.
Patrolling up Victoria St, all clear.
Welfare check on 77 Convenience Store, all clear.
Patrolling Federal St toward Wyndham St, all clear.
Patrolling down Wyndham St toward Queen St, all clear.
Welfare checks on Q Convenience Store and Customs Mart, all clear.
Patrolling Fort Lane, Fort St and bottom of High St, all clear.
Welfare check on High Street Supermarket, all clear.
Full sweep Chancery Square and Freyberg Square, all clear; Echo Route complete.
Welfare check at the bottom of Hobson St, all clear.
Welfare check on 77 Convenience Store, top of Victoria St, all clear.
Patrol down Victoria St toward Queen St and Lorne St, all clear; Charlie Route complete.
Handover to morning shift; night shift concluded.
